summary.text: Walter "Rocky" Beach, an unaffiliated paramedic of more than 37 years from Gonzales who co-founded EMS Reform, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Louisiana's 2nd Congressional District to Troy Carter Sr.
He describes himself as "not a career politician."

paragraphs.text: Beach graduated from Chester High School and earned an associate degree from the University of Louisiana at Lafayette in 1991 and a bachelor's degree from Southeastern Louisiana University in 2004.
He says he has worked as a paramedic for more than 37 years alongside firefighters, law enforcement, dispatchers, nurses and doctors, and he describes himself as "not a career politician."
The Louisiana Illuminator's voter guide describes him as a paramedic who advocates for first responders.
During the campaign, his website focused on EMS funding, first responder protections and ending ambulance monopolies.
He received 1.1% of the vote to Troy Carter Sr.'s 79.9%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
